description: This file defines an Android activity 'ScaleToFit' that demonstrates different scaling modes (FILL, START, CENTER, END) for drawing shapes within a view, specifically drawing ovals and rectangles and applying matrix transformations for fitting content within a specified viewport.

classes.name: ScaleToFit
classes.description: An Android activity that showcases how to scale graphics to fit within a view using different scaling modes.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: A custom View class nested within ScaleToFit that handles the drawing of ovals and rectangles with different scale to fit options.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Android activity lifecycle method initializing the activity and setting the content view to an instance of SampleView.

methods.name: setSrcR
methods.description: Sets the source rectangle size based on an index in the sample data.

methods.name: drawSrcR
methods.description: Draws an oval in the canvas using the current source rectangle.

methods.name: drawFit
methods.description: Applies a ScaleToFit mode to fit a source rectangle into the destination rectangle and draws it.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles the drawing of the entire view, including multiple scaled shapes and labels.

methods.name: SampleView
methods.description: Constructor initializing paints and the view.
